prepared_by: XPROT workflow lane (draft for the project owner; not an owner decision)
tools: protocol_tools.py (schema-subset validator, derived-value check, numeric-register rendering, schedule generator)
purpose: Common-condition experimental comparison of three ionization architectures feeding the same Hall acceleration stage (Hall-only, RF pre-ionizer + Hall, ECR pre-ionizer + Hall), in which the pre-ionizer is the only change and every consumer is accounted at the same DC input bus boundary.

scope.rfp_block: ionization/discharge -> acceleration/thrust block of the RFP architecture (atmospheric path: intake -> filter -> compressor -> atmospheric gas chamber -> valve; Xe path: Xe chamber -> valve). The experiment starts at the valve outlets; intake, filter, compressor and gas chambers are replaced by laboratory gas supplies and are outside this experiment.
in_scope: discharge/ionization and acceleration performance of the three arms at identical propellant composition, total mass flow, Hall channel, magnetic configuration, discharge voltage, cathode, facility and diagnostics
bus-power accounting at the DC input bus boundary for every consumer, identical for all arms
out_of_scope: intake, filter, compressor, gas-chamber and spacecraft-level performance (the upstream ICD supplies the delivered flow and composition)
atomic oxygen: bottled O2/N2 mixtures cannot reproduce intake-delivered atomic O; this is a declared limitation, not a surrogate claim
any change to Vyovrinda's own Hall geometry between arms

non_claims: This protocol makes no claim about which architecture performs better; it defines how the comparison is measured and classified.

No simulator prediction of arm differences is used or registered here. The Hall transport credible set is empty and gate 3 is FAIL (CLAUDE.md gate table); all absolute Hall results of the withdrawn 0-D closure are not quoted.
No demonstrated ABEP closure, architecture selection or transport admission is claimed or implied.
The P5-N2 v1 validation outcome is unaffected; nothing here re-scores, re-labels or re-interprets any v1 run.

relation_to_repository.evidence_level_of_results: in-house measurement on Vyovrinda hardware = evidence level 1 (docs/EVIDENCE.md hierarchy); quantity type 'measured' for direct readings, 'inferred' or 'reconstructed' for derived quantities, each with its transformation chain
relation_to_repository.prior_plan_item: docs/HISTORY.md 'What to feed it next' lists measurements of utilization for Hall-only vs ECR/RF-assisted operation on N2 and O; this protocol is a common-condition design for that item (no numbers from that section are used)
relation_to_repository.bus_boundary_definition: bus_power_boundary_v1 (defined by a separate lane in abep_sim/arch_boundary.py, BOUNDARY_VERSION 'bus_power_boundary_v1'); referenced by name only, not imported
relation_to_repository.experiment_material_alignment: docs/experiments/ is not present at the base commit; alignment with any later experiment material is an owner review item

arms.label: RF pre-ionizer + Hall

dc_input_power_levels.tbd_requires: RF pre-ionizer design; the level set must include zero (sham) and at least the number of non-zero levels in design.pre_ionizer_power_levels_min

feed_topology.tbd_requires: hardware decision: series (all propellant through the pre-ionizer) or parallel (split m_dot_p / m_dot_prop); fixed and pre-registered

arms.only_change_vs_reference: RF pre-ionizer energized (and, in CFG-B, its applicator installed); every common_conditions invariant held

arms.label: ECR pre-ionizer + Hall

pre_ionizer.resonance_condition: B_res = 2 pi f m_e / e (fixed by the chosen frequency; the resonance-field magnets must not perturb the Hall channel field beyond the INV-MAG tolerance)

dc_input_power_levels.tbd_requires: ECR pre-ionizer design; the level set must include zero (sham) and at least the number of non-zero levels in design.pre_ionizer_power_levels_min

feed_topology.tbd_requires: hardware decision: series or parallel propellant feed; fixed and pre-registered

arms.only_change_vs_reference: ECR pre-ionizer energized (and, in CFG-B, its applicator and resonance magnets installed); every common_conditions invariant held

controls.purpose: separates the effect of installing the RF applicator (gas path, volume, surfaces) from the effect of energizing it
controls.definition: RF applicator installed, generator not energized, all other settings as RF_HALL
controls.required_in: CFG-B (in CFG-A the HALL_ONLY arm is this control for both applicators)

controls.purpose: separates the effect of installing the ECR applicator and its resonance magnets from the effect of energizing it
controls.definition: ECR applicator and resonance magnets installed, microwave source not energized, all other settings as ECR_HALL
controls.required_in: CFG-B (in CFG-A the HALL_ONLY arm is this control for both applicators)

controls.purpose: quantifies electromagnetic pickup of the RF generator and microwave source on every common diagnostic
controls.definition: each generator drives a matched dummy load (no plasma, no flow) at every pre-registered power level while all common diagnostics record; repeated in every pump-down

controls.purpose: detects drift of the Hall channel, cathode, thrust stand and diagnostics over the campaign
controls.definition: HALL_ONLY arm at the Xe reference point at the start and end of every test day

hardware_configurations.name: integrated article
hardware_configurations.definition: one test article carries both pre-ionizer applicators; arms are selected electrically without venting; HALL_ONLY = both applicators installed and unenergized
hardware_configurations.advantage: arms can be randomized within a pump-down; the gas path and magnetic circuit are physically identical across arms
hardware_configurations.risk: the two applicators may interfere (field perturbation, gas-path volume); feasibility TBD by hardware design
hardware_configurations.status: PROPOSED as the preferred configuration, subject to feasibility

hardware_configurations.name: separate builds
hardware_configurations.definition: three builds (bare Hall, RF + Hall, ECR + Hall) plus the two sham builds; a vent separates builds
hardware_configurations.risk: reassembly variance and vent/re-conditioning effects; controlled by replicate builds and the XE_HEALTH_CHECK

common_conditions.principle: the pre-ionizer (its applicator and its energization) is the only change between arms; every invariant below is verified and logged at every operating point

invariants.quantity: propellant composition delivered to the discharge (anode + pre-ionizer lines)
invariants.rule: same certified gas source (same cylinder lot for premixed O2/N2) or the same calibrated per-species controllers, for all arms at a given point
invariants.verification: cylinder certificate or per-species MFC readings logged; composition uncertainty stated

threshold.rule: per-species mole-fraction difference between arms at the same point <= {inv_prop_tol}

parameters.tbd_requires: gas-supply specification and the composition uncertainty of the chosen supply

invariants.quantity: propellant mass flow m_dot_prop = m_dot_a + m_dot_p and cathode flow m_dot_c
invariants.rule: m_dot_prop and m_dot_c identical across arms at each point, set by the same calibrated controllers; m_dot_p = 0 in HALL_ONLY; the split m_dot_p / m_dot_prop is fixed per arm and pre-registered
invariants.verification: controller readings logged at >= the pressure sampling rate; periodic in-situ flow verification (calibrator) per Snyder et al. 2017 Sec. IV

threshold.rule: |m_dot_prop,arm / m_dot_prop,HALL_ONLY - 1| <= {inv_flow_tol} and the same for m_dot_c

parameters.tbd_requires: MFC calibration uncertainty on the working gas (from the pre-campaign calibration)

invariants.quantity: Hall channel, anode and gas distributor
invariants.rule: same serial-numbered channel, anode and distributor in every arm; channel dimensions measured before and after the campaign
invariants.verification: serial numbers logged per pump-down; dimensional inspection report

threshold.rule: channel width and depth change over the campaign <= {inv_channel_tol}

parameters.tbd_requires: Hall channel design and metrology capability

invariants.rule: same magnet hardware and coil currents in every arm; B(z) (and B(r) at the channel exit) mapped in every hardware configuration with every pre-ionizer magnet installed
invariants.verification: Gauss-probe map per configuration; coil currents logged at every point

threshold.rule: peak |B| on the channel centreline differs by <= {inv_mag_peak_tol} and its axial location by <= {inv_mag_loc_tol} between configurations; otherwise the comparison is flagged CONFOUNDED_MAGNETIC and reported, not scored

parameters.tbd_requires: Hall magnetic design and Gauss-probe uncertainty
Hall magnetic design and probe positioning uncertainty

invariants.rule: identical V_d set points for all arms, regulated at the thruster terminals (voltage sense), constant-voltage mode; flow is not adjusted by discharge-current feedback

threshold.rule: |V_d,arm - V_d,set| <= {inv_vd_tol}

invariants.rule: same Xe-fed LaB6 hollow cathode (serial number), position, Xe flow, heater and keeper settings and electrical configuration in every arm (cathode type per the task definition and the repository default neutralizer lab6_xe in abep_sim/archengine.py; owner to confirm)
invariants.verification: cathode-to-ground and keeper voltages logged at every point as cathode-health indicators

threshold.rule: XE_HEALTH_CHECK cathode-to-ground voltage drift over the campaign <= {inv_cath_drift}

parameters.tbd_requires: cathode specification and Hall-only pilot repeatability

invariants.rule: same chamber, pump configuration, thruster position and reference-pressure gauges for all arms; reference pressure reported near the chamber wall at the thruster exit plane (Dankanich et al. 2017 Sec. IV.A); arms are compared only at matched reference pressure
invariants.verification: reference pressure logged at every point; gauge calibration records

threshold.rule: |p_ref,arm / p_ref,HALL_ONLY - 1| <= {inv_fac_tol} for a paired comparison

parameters.tbd_requires: facility characterization (pressure sensitivity of the Hall-only arm from the pilot)

invariants.rule: same instruments, positions, calibrations and data-reduction code for all arms; arm-specific monitoring (forward/reflected power) is additive and shown non-perturbing by DUMMY_LOAD_PICKUP
invariants.verification: instrument serial numbers, positions and calibration dates logged per pump-down

threshold.rule: pickup measured in DUMMY_LOAD_PICKUP on each common diagnostic <= {inv_diag_pickup} of that diagnostic's expanded uncertainty

parameters.tbd_requires: owner decision after the diagnostic uncertainty budget is known

invariants.rule: same grounding/floating scheme of thruster body and cathode, same cabling, filters and supplies for all arms
invariants.verification: configuration photograph and checklist per pump-down

invariants.rule: a point is measured only after the same pre-registered thermal-settling criterion is met in every arm (thrust-stand and thruster temperatures)

threshold.rule: rate of change of each monitored temperature <= {inv_therm_rate} before a point is recorded

invariants.rule: bus_power_boundary_v1 with the same component list, measurement points and instrument classes in every arm (bus_power_boundary.components)
invariants.verification: per-point bus-power record with one row per component, no missing rows

definitions.m_dot_a: propellant flow to the Hall anode/gas distributor
definitions.m_dot_p: propellant flow injected into the pre-ionizer (0 in HALL_ONLY; equals m_dot_prop for a series feed)
definitions.m_dot_prop: m_dot_a + m_dot_p, the matched discharge-propellant flow
definitions.m_dot_c: Xe flow to the LaB6 cathode
definitions.m_dot_tot: m_dot_prop + m_dot_c, used in every efficiency and utilization denominator
definitions.m_dot_transient: any ignition or conditioning puff on any line, logged and reported with the ignition metric

rules: every line (anode, pre-ionizer, cathode) has its own calibrated controller and logged reading
m_dot_prop and m_dot_c are the matched quantities between arms; the split m_dot_p / m_dot_prop is fixed per arm and pre-registered

controllers are calibrated on each working gas and mixture in the final configuration, traceable to a national metrology standard, within the calibration interval below (Snyder et al. 2017 Sec. IV and VI)
facility-ingested background gas is not a controlled flow: it is characterized through the reference pressure and the background-pressure sweep, never added to m_dot_tot

mfc_calibration_interval.source: REF-SNYDER2017 Sec. VI ('Calibrations should be traceable to NIST and performed at least every 12 months over the entire flow scale')

bus_power_boundary.boundary_point: DC input bus: every consumer is measured (or, where labelled, reconstructed) at its input terminals from the common DC bus
bus_power_boundary.laboratory_bus_emulation: preferred: all consumers fed from one laboratory DC bus supply at the ICD bus voltage through breadboard or flight-like converters, with a main-bus meter and one branch meter per component; where a laboratory supply replaces a bus-fed converter, bus-side power is reconstructed as P_out / eta_conv with eta_conv measured for that converter at that load and labelled 'reconstructed'
bus_power_boundary.consistency_note: The component list follows the consumer list given for bus_power_boundary_v1 in the lane definition. Name-by-name mapping to the component identifiers in abep_sim/arch_boundary.py is an open item to check when that module is merged (this protocol does not import it).

components.name: Hall PPU (discharge converter) DC input
components.includes: discharge-converter conversion loss, output filter and cabling to the thruster; i.e. everything between the bus and the anode/cathode terminals
components.measurement: branch DC power meter at the converter input (4-wire voltage sense, calibrated shunt or zero-flux current transducer, simultaneous V and I sampling); discharge-side V_d and I_d also recorded to report eta_conv
components.quantity_type: measured (bus-fed converter) or reconstructed (laboratory supply, P_d / eta_conv)

components.name: magnet supplies DC input
components.includes: Hall coil supplies and any pre-ionizer (e.g. ECR resonance or helicon) coil supplies, reported as sub-items; 0 W rows for permanent magnets are still reported
components.measurement: branch DC power meter per supply input

components.name: RF generator DC input
components.includes: generator conversion loss, matching network and RF cable losses (everything between the bus and the antenna); forward and reflected power at the generator output and at the applicator are recorded as diagnostics only
components.measurement: branch DC power meter at the generator DC input; directional coupler and RF power meter as diagnostics

components.name: microwave source DC input
components.includes: source conversion loss, isolator/circulator, tuner, waveguide/coax and window losses (everything between the bus and the applicator); forward and reflected power recorded as diagnostics only
components.measurement: branch DC power meter at the source DC input; directional coupler and power meter as diagnostics

components.name: cathode heater supply DC input
components.includes: heater converter loss; reported separately for steady state and for the start-up (ignition) phase as energy

components.name: valves and flow control DC input
components.includes: valve drivers and flow controllers on every propellant line (anode, pre-ionizer, cathode); laboratory-only controller power is reported as a flagged sub-item

components.name: thermal control DC input
components.includes: heaters and active cooling that the flight system would power for the thruster, pre-ionizer and PPU; facility-provided cooling is disclosed separately (facility_services_disclosure)

components.name: housekeeping DC input
components.includes: control, telemetry and sensor electronics of the propulsion string

bus_power_boundary.presence_rule: every component row is recorded for every arm at every point. A physically absent component is recorded as 0 W with presence ABSENT; an installed but unenergized component is measured (standby draw), never assumed zero. A missing row makes P_bus,total undefined for that point (status EXCLUDED_MISSING_BOUNDARY_COMPONENT); no placeholder is ever filled in.
bus_power_boundary.totals: P_bus,total = sum over all components; the per-component breakdown is reported for every point and arm
facility_services_disclosure: facility cooling water or gas for any generator, applicator, magnet or PPU: heat load reported per arm (calorimetric or flow x temperature rise), outside the bus boundary but disclosed because flight would reject it through the thermal subsystem
facility pumping and laboratory instrumentation are not propulsion consumers and are excluded, identically for all arms

ledger_check.definition: residual = |P_main - sum of branch meters| / P_main at every point, where P_main is the main-bus meter

threshold.rule: residual <= {ledger_residual_max}; otherwise the point is EXCLUDED_INSTRUMENT

parameters.source: CLAUDE.md rule 4 (architecture energy-ledger residual < 2 % for the simulator); adoption for the experimental ledger is a proposal

uncertainty_targets.instrument_class: DC power analyzer channels with calibration traceable to a national metrology standard, 4-wire voltage sensing at the consumer input, simultaneous voltage and current sampling, stated bandwidth covering converter ripple

threshold.rule: expanded relative uncertainty of P_bus,total at every point <= {bus_unc_ratio} x delta_m1 (the pre-registered minimum effect of interest of M1); per-component budgets are allocated so that their root-sum-square meets this target

parameters.source: XPROT draft proposal, analogous to the common 4:1 test-uncertainty-ratio convention (from memory - verify); not derived from data

common.instrument: pendulum-type thrust stand with in-situ end-to-end calibration of the whole installation including pre-ionizer feed lines (RF cables, waveguide or coax) crossing the stand interface (Polk et al. 2017 Sec. IV)
common.procedure: calibrations before and after each operating sequence and zero measurement with thruster off (Polk et al. 2017 Sec. V.A); thermocouples on the stand for drift tracking (Sec. VI.B); uncertainty budget reported (Sec. VI.C, VII)

calibrations_before.source: REF-POLK2017 Sec. V.A ('Perform a minimum of ten calibrations to generate a calibration curve')

calibrations_after.source: REF-POLK2017 Sec. V.A ('Perform a minimum of ten calibrations after thruster operation')

uncertainty_target.rule: expanded relative thrust uncertainty <= {thrust_unc_ratio} x delta_m1, and the pre/post calibration sensitivity shift contributes <= {thrust_cal_shift_max} of the total thrust uncertainty, otherwise EXCLUDED_INSTRUMENT

parameters.source: XPROT draft proposal (same ratio as THR-UNC-BUS); not derived from data

common.quantity: V_d, I_d (DC and time-resolved), cathode-to-ground and keeper voltages, coil currents
common.instrument: calibrated DC meters plus a high-bandwidth current probe on the discharge line

sampling_rate.tbd_requires: oscillation band observed in the Hall-only pilot, with anti-alias filtering; the same rate for all arms

common.quantity: ion current density map, beam current I_b, divergence
common.instrument: Faraday probe sweep at fixed radius, same probe and positions in all arms
common.procedure: per the recommended practice REF-BROWN2017 (full text not accessed by this lane - verify the applicable corrections before pre-registration)

common.quantity: species and charge-state current fractions (N2+, N+, O2+, O+, NO+ if present, multiply charged ions, Xe+ from the cathode flow)
common.instrument: E x B probe (or equivalent species-resolving diagnostic); required mass resolution TBD
common.procedure: spectrum analysis per REF-SHASTRY2009 (metadata only accessed - verify); same analysis code for all arms

mass_resolution.tbd_requires: species set of the O2/N2 mixtures from the upstream ICD and E x B probe design

common.procedure: recommended-practice reference TBD (none located by this lane); same analyzer and position for all arms

common.instrument: hot-cathode ionization gauges calibrated on each working gas and mixture with their controller, cabling and feedthrough (Dankanich et al. 2017 Sec. III)
common.placement: near the chamber wall at the thruster exit plane (Dankanich et al. 2017 Sec. IV.A)

gauge_radial_offset_min.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('at least 0.6 chamber radii away from the centerline')

gauge_distance_from_thruster_min.unit: m from the thruster outer diameter (minimum)
gauge_distance_from_thruster_min.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('at least 1 m from the outer diameter of the thruster')

settling_after_flow_change.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('no less than 2 min after a commanded flow-rate change greater than 10%')

sampling_rate_min.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('The sampling rate should be no less than 10 Hz')

averaging_window.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('pressure should be measured as the 3 s average value')

gauge_calibration_interval.unit: months (maximum; or the operating-hour limit below, whichever is less)

radial_asymmetry.rule: asymmetric pressure variation at the thruster exit plane one thruster radius from the outer channel wall < {pressure_asym_max}

parameters.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.A ('Asymmetric pressure variation should be less than 20%')

mixture_gas_correction.tbd_requires: calibration of the gauges on each O2/N2 mixture (N2 is the industry reference gas; REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. II.A.2 and III: calibration on the gas of interest, if practical, gives higher precision than a gas correction factor)

common.procedure: per REF-SNYDER2017 Sec. IV and VI

common.quantity: per-component DC input power and P_main
common.procedure: one record per component per point; averaging window equal to the thrust averaging window

common.quantity: thrust-stand, thruster, applicator and PPU temperatures
common.procedure: used for INV-THERM and drift correction

arm_specific_additive.quantity: RF forward/reflected power at generator output and applicator
arm_specific_additive.use: diagnostic and stability metric S5 only; never substitutes for the DC input power
diagnostic and stability metric S5 only; never substitutes for the DC input power

arm_specific_additive.quantity: pre-ionizer chamber pressure (if a port exists)

test_matrix.principle: operating-point values are parameters; values the upstream ICD must supply are TBD and are never invented here

levels.label: Xe reference
levels.tbd_requires: owner choice of the Xe reference point (flow and voltage) for drift checks and cross-facility comparison

levels.label: O2/N2 mixtures
levels.tbd_requires: upstream ICD: composition delivered at the valve outlet across the RFP altitude envelope (abep_sim/constants.py RFPConstraints.alt_min_km to alt_max_km) and solar conditions (intake -> filter -> compressor -> gas chamber); not invented here
upstream ICD: delivered mass-flow range at the valve outlet; the set must include the lowest ICD-delivered flow
LaB6 cathode specification (owner/supplier); identical in all arms
Hall magnetic design (owner); fixed across arms
arms[].pre_ionizer.dc_input_power_levels (RF and ECR designs); includes zero
facility characterization: base level at maximum facility capability plus elevated levels spanning the expected operating range

test_matrix.matrix_rule: the primary matrix is F-PROP x F-MDOT x F-VD at base background pressure for every arm (and sham controls in CFG-B), with the pre-ionizer at each of its non-zero power levels; the background-pressure sweep and the minimum-flow search are run on a pre-registered subset of points (subset TBD by the owner)

randomisation.within_day: propellant blocks in the fixed order Xe reference -> N2 -> O2/N2 (oxygen exposure may change cathode and wall surfaces irreversibly, so oxygen-containing points are not interleaved with the others); inside each block the operating points are shuffled and, in CFG-A, the arm order is shuffled inside each point
randomisation.between_builds: CFG-B: build order balanced over replicate builds (each build installed at least twice, HALL_ONLY build revisited between test-arm builds)
randomisation.algorithm: protocol_tools.randomized_schedule (deterministic given the seed); the seed is drawn and recorded at pre-registration

seed.tbd_requires: drawn at pre-registration and recorded in the lock

replication.definition: a replicate is an independent visit to the point separated by a thruster shutdown and restart (and, in CFG-B, preferably a re-installation)

replicates_min.source: XPROT draft proposal; the final count follows a power analysis on Hall-only pilot variance (TBD)

pre_ionizer_power_levels_min.unit: non-zero power levels per pre-ionizer arm
pre_ionizer_power_levels_min.source: XPROT draft proposal (needed to see a dose-response rather than a single point)

drift_controls: XE_HEALTH_CHECK at the start and end of every day
thrust-stand calibrations before and after each sequence (DIAG-THRUST)
arm order randomized so that drift cannot align with arm
design.blinding: the analysis pipeline is frozen and run with coded arm labels; labels are decoded only after the per-metric classification is produced (PROPOSED)
design.conditioning: the same pre-registered conditioning sequence (bake-out, cathode activation, Hall conditioning on Xe) after every vent, identical for all arms

facility_effect_controls.method: background pressure is raised by supplemental injection of the same working gas downstream of the thruster, at least one pumping surface between injection and gauge, and preferably near the facility centreline; the baseline is at maximum facility pumping capability (Dankanich et al. 2017 Sec. IV.B)

elevated_levels_min.unit: elevated background-pressure levels in addition to the base level
elevated_levels_min.source: XPROT draft proposal (two elevated levels allow a slope and a curvature check)

injection_distance_min.unit: m downstream of the thruster exit plane (minimum)
injection_distance_min.source: REF-DANKANICH2017 Sec. IV.B ('at least 2 m downstream of the thruster exit plane or preferably near the centerline of the facility')

facility_effect_controls.analysis: for every arm and swept point, each metric is regressed on p_ref; arm-by-pressure interaction is reported. An arm difference that is present at base pressure but whose sign or classification changes within the swept range is reported as FACILITY_SENSITIVE and is not carried as a vacuum-representative result. Extrapolation to zero pressure is a secondary, model-based analysis and is labelled 'reconstructed'.
facility_effect_controls.never_crossed: a paired comparison is made only at matched reference pressure (THR-INV-FAC); results at different pressures are never compared directly
facility_effect_controls.precedent: the P5-N2 reference data required a facility ingestion correction (Brabston et al. 2025, as audited in hallthruster_bridge/identification/brabston_p5_n2_measurement_audit_v1.json), which is why the sweep is mandatory for every arm

ignition.definition: an ignition attempt follows the pre-registered start sequence (cathode heater, keeper, flows, pre-ionizer where applicable, discharge supply). Success: I_d reaches the steady window within the timeout and remains sustained for the hold time.

extinction.definition_source: same functional form as the simulation rule O1 (hallthruster_bridge/prereg/p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json operational_rules.O1_extinction_SUSTAINMENT) so that experiment and simulation use one definition; applied over an experimental hold window

threshold.rule: uncommanded extinction iff BOTH the mean I_d over the hold window < {ext_mean_frac} x I_d,ref AND >= {ext_sample_share} of I_d samples in that window < {ext_sample_frac} x I_d,ref, with I_d,ref the median I_d of the preceding steady window of duration {ext_window}

parameters.source: p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json operational_rules.O1 (project decision for simulation scoring); adoption for experiments is a proposal
p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json operational_rules.O1; adoption for experiments is a proposal
p5_n2_validation_criteria_v1.json operational_rules.O1; adoption for experiments is a proposal

parameters.tbd_requires: discharge oscillation band from the Hall-only pilot

extinction.not_extinction: a low but steady discharge is sustained; a single deep breathing trough is not an extinction

sustainment_and_extinction.minimum_sustained_flow_search: at fixed V_d and magnet setting, m_dot_prop is stepped down (pre-registered step and dwell) until extinction or the facility/controller limit; the lowest sustained step is m_dot_min for that arm. Extinctions are data (metric M6 and S6), never exclusions.

flow_step.tbd_requires: MFC resolution and owner decision; it sets the resolution of M6

stability_metrics.name: relative discharge-current oscillation
stability_metrics.definition: sigma(I_d) / mean(I_d) over the steady window, in the pre-registered band

stability_metrics.name: peak-to-peak discharge-current oscillation
stability_metrics.definition: (max - min)(I_d) / mean(I_d) over the steady window

stability_metrics.name: dominant oscillation frequency
stability_metrics.definition: frequency of the largest peak of the I_d power spectral density in the pre-registered band

stability_metrics.name: thrust noise
stability_metrics.definition: standard deviation of the thrust-stand signal over the steady window after drift correction

stability_metrics.name: pre-ionizer coupling stability
stability_metrics.definition: mean and standard deviation of reflected/forward power ratio (pre-ionizer arms only; diagnostic)

stability_metrics.name: uncommanded extinctions and mode transitions
stability_metrics.definition: count per hour of operation per arm and propellant

statuses.VALID: all invariants within tolerance, all instruments valid, every bus component recorded
statuses.EXCLUDED_FACILITY: reference pressure outside the matched band, gauge fault or asymmetry beyond THR-PRESSURE-ASYM
statuses.EXCLUDED_INSTRUMENT: thrust-stand calibration shift beyond THR-UNC-THRUST, ledger residual beyond THR-LEDGER, or another instrument fault
statuses.EXCLUDED_MISSING_BOUNDARY_COMPONENT: any bus_power_boundary_v1 component not recorded; P_bus,total undefined
statuses.CONFOUNDED_MAGNETIC: INV-MAG tolerance missed for the configuration
statuses.NOT_IGNITED: ignition attempt failed; counted in M5
statuses.NOT_SUSTAINED: uncommanded extinction per THR-EXTINCTION; counted in M6 and S6

rules: excluded points are reported with their reason, never deleted
NOT_IGNITED and NOT_SUSTAINED are outcomes, not exclusions
re-runs of excluded points are scheduled at the end of the same block with the same randomization rule; the re-run cap is pre-registered (TBD)

decision_metrics.name: thrust per bus power
decision_metrics.definition: T / P_bus,total at matched point and reference pressure
decision_metrics.comparison: paired ratio R = M1(arm) / M1(HALL_ONLY) at the same point, day and pressure

threshold.rule: classify HIGHER if the lower bound of the two-sided {confidence_level} confidence interval of R exceeds unity by more than {delta_m1}; LOWER if the upper bound is below unity by more than {delta_m1}; otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHED

decision_metrics.name: beam ion current per bus power
decision_metrics.definition: I_b / P_bus,total, I_b from the Faraday-probe integration (DIAG-FARADAY)

threshold.rule: as THR-M1 with {delta_m2} at the {confidence_level_m2} level

parameters.tbd_requires: owner: minimum effect of interest for M2

decision_metrics.name: mass utilization
decision_metrics.definition: eta_m,tot = sum_j (m_j / (q_j e)) I_b,j / m_dot_tot with I_b,j = I_b x Omega_j (E x B current fraction of species j, charge state q_j, mass m_j from standard atomic weights); eta_m,prop (propellant species only over m_dot_prop) reported alongside

threshold.rule: as THR-M1 with {delta_m3} at the {confidence_level_m3} level

parameters.tbd_requires: owner: minimum effect of interest for M3

threshold.rule: classify NOT_WORSE if the upper bound of the two-sided {confidence_level_m4} confidence interval of the S1 ratio is <= unity plus {delta_m4}; WORSE if its lower bound exceeds unity plus {delta_m4}; otherwise NOT_DISTINGUISHED

decision_metrics.name: ignition reliability

decision_metrics.comparison: each arm against the owner's minimum reliability; arms compared descriptively

threshold.rule: MEETS if the one-sided {ignition_confidence} Clopper-Pearson lower bound of the ignition success probability over {ignition_attempts} attempts is >= {ignition_p_min}; otherwise NOT_DEMONSTRATED

derived.source: derived by protocol_tools.py: rfp_thrust_min / rfp_power_max. A point with T >= rfp_thrust_min at total system power < rfp_power_max has T / P_system > this value, and P_bus,lab <= P_system, so T / P_bus,lab > this value is necessary

statistics.unit_of_analysis: paired (arm, HALL_ONLY) visits to the same point in the same day and matched reference pressure
statistics.interval_method: ratio confidence intervals from replicate-level paired log-ratios (t-interval on log R); bootstrap over replicates as a cross-check (PROPOSED)
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down correction across the pre-registered primary family (M1 at every primary point and arm); secondary metrics reported with unadjusted and adjusted intervals (PROPOSED)
statistics.aggregation: no composite score and no single overall ranking; the output is the per-metric, per-point, per-arm classification table. Any aggregation rule must be pre-registered by the owner before measurement.

ignition_decision_aid.note: zero-failure demonstration: the one-sided lower confidence bound on the success probability after n successes in n attempts is (1 - c)^(1/n); the smallest n that demonstrates a target p is ceil(ln(1 - c) / ln p). Illustrative targets only; the owner sets ignition_p_min.

preregistration.rule: no score-bearing measurement before the pre-registration is locked and merged (mirrors hallthruster_bridge/prereg practice)

steps.step: owner resolves every TBD and every PROPOSED item (accept, change or reject) and records the decision; status moves from DRAFT_PENDING_OWNER to REGISTERED only by an owner decision

pilot phase, disclosed: Hall-only repeatability and facility characterization; pre-ionizer arms limited to functional checkout (ignition, matching, dummy-load pickup) with no thrust, current or utilization metric computed for them. Pilot data never enter the decision analysis.
freeze: protocol JSON (status REGISTERED), analysis code, schedule seed, upstream-ICD revision, instrument calibration certificates list; write a sha256 lock file of these artefacts
merge the lock; only then run the campaign
any later change is a dated addendum that discloses what data had been seen; the lock is never edited
raw data frozen with sha256 before analysis; the per-metric classification table is produced by the frozen code with coded arm labels
